compute_budget_definition: GPU seconds allowed per arm per eight-replica ensemble invocation, excluding fixed untimed warmups. At each of three caps perform all four seed groups and all repetitions. Caps are censoring limits, not permission to alter work, sample spacing or number of replicas. Report total evaluation cost separately; total cost includes all seed groups, repetitions and warmups. No partial ensemble counts as success.

confidence_rule.decision: Executable v1 exact binomial order-statistic inference. Performance: one-sided 95% lower confidence bound of paired baseline/method wall-time ratios must exceed 1.05. Equivalence: alpha=0.05; two-sided intervals with Bonferroni across two metrics, each tail <=0.0125; require entire interval strictly inside corresponding +/- absolute margin. All metrics and all budgets must pass for method acceptance; no selection of favorable budgets. Lack of significance is not equivalence. Failed or censored runs cannot establish acceptance.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work benchmark: exactly eight 25000-step replicas and 100 energy samples per replica; energy is not a monotone quality-versus-compute target. Scientific preservation assessed separately through two paired equivalence metrics.

equivalence_metrics.name: final_potential_kj_mol
equivalence_metrics.source: results/reproduce/out/run/ensemble.json: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of final_potential_kj_mol across eight baseline replica seeds 1000 through 1007; absolute margin is one such measured standard deviation, in kJ/mol. Baseline variability scale, not a published scientific acceptance tolerance or same-seed repeatability estimate.

equivalence_metrics.source: results/reproduce/out/run/ensemble.json: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of mean_potential_kj_mol across eight baseline replica seeds 1000 through 1007; absolute margin is one such measured standard deviation, in kJ/mol. evaluation_inputs.generated_inputs: For each seed use published equilibrated coordinates; setVelocitiesToTemperature(300 K,seed) and integrator.setRandomNumberSeed(seed). Groups 2000..2007, 2008..2015, 2016..2023, 2024..2031 each define one eight-replica ensemble. Same fixed input geometry for all groups.
evaluation_inputs.unavailable_evidence: Full energy series not persisted; equivalence claims restricted to final and mean energies. Transitive package lock unavailable; hold baseline installed dependencies fixed.

evidence_and_assumptions.concurrency: Measured MPS whole-workload concurrency factors 1.1821874199547162 at two concurrent runs and 1.3022796708350082 at four. These are ceilings for prospective methods, not measured method speedups. GPU utilization unavailable. Profile wall 64.62697200000002 s differs from anchor 61.96588431400005 s; do not treat as method comparison.
evidence_and_assumptions.reference: anchors_scored.json gives no reference pass/fail tolerance; approximate 5 microseconds/day reference is not an acceptance target.
evidence_and_assumptions.scientific_limitations: Margins use measured across-seed variability, not exact identity and not repeated same-seed noise. No published numerical scientific margin; eight-seed calibration may be imprecise. Statistical equivalence is of median paired summary differences, not individual trajectories or entire distributions.

hardware_cost_basis.description: Same physical NVIDIA A10, driver 570.148.08, CUDA platform, one reserved GPU per arm; elapsed measured scope multiplied by one GPU. Source: results/reproduce/out/probe.json. Include GPU reservation while host launches, transfers, merges, or waits. No GPU count scaling.

infeasible_methods.reason: One measured GPU; equal-GPU-second bound 1, below 1.05. k=max(1,gpu_count)=1.
Transfer fraction 0.0020856981446507774; k=2 Amdahl bound 1.001043937741831, below 1.05.

paired_seed_tests.description: Pair baseline and method by identical held-out seed and input. Langevin thermostat and velocity initialization are stochastic despite fixed seeds and DeterministicForces. Compare method-minus-baseline per-replica energy summaries. Eight replicas per ensemble; four fixed ensembles cover 32 seeds. Timing repetitions do not count as independent scientific seeds. At each budget, aggregate repeated same-seed summaries by median before paired-seed inference; do not pool seeds across budgets.

predicted_outcome.reason: Fixed-work benchmark; no calibrated energy-versus-compute outcome curve.

uncertainty.outcome_evidence: No held-out energy measurements or scientifically calibrated numeric outcome forecast available. Both energy metrics must pass sealed paired-seed equivalence. Budget caps do not change scientific work.
uncertainty.speedup_assumption: Assume two concurrent replica workers with fixed input partitioning under MPS. Measured two-run factor 1.1822 and four-run ceiling 1.3023 support modest headroom; 39.6% host API time may overlap. Allow startup, replicated initialization, transfers and result merge; interval is prospective, not measured.

power.assumptions: Prospective, unvalidated power model: independent held-out seed differences, with probability at most 0.1 in each tail beyond each sealed absolute margin, for both metrics. No measured paired method differences exist. This is a design assumption, not estimated power from method outputs.
power.calculation: With n=32, use order ranks 10 and 23. Union bound over two tails for two metrics: 1 - 4*P(Binomial(32,0.1)>=10).
power.limitations: No unconditional power guarantee; across-seed SD estimates use only eight baseline samples. Their uncertainty and same-seed baseline variability are unavailable.

scheduling_protocol: For each method and budget, perform 32 timing pairs per seed group. Use seeded random fair coin to choose baseline-first or method-first within each pair, randomize group order per repetition. Arms never overlap. Record pair order and GPU identity. Preserve all pairs; no outlier deletion. Performance observation is baseline/method ensemble makespan ratio, aggregated equally over fixed groups; repeated pairs supply timing inference.

splits.description: Single published molecular input; no learned model or input training split. Baseline seeds supply margin calibration only. Held-out random streams used for evaluation, never method tuning. No trajectory-identity claim.

timing_scope.description: Complete fixed-work ensemble makespan: before first integrator/context or worker launch through completion, synchronization, merge of eight summaries and teardown of all contexts/workers. Include launch, initialization, compilation within scope, H2D/D2H transfers, energy queries and merge overhead. Both arms use same boundaries, matching intake/EXECUTION.json except candidate worker launch and merge explicitly included. PDB parsing/system creation before scope; JSON serialization after scope. Never sum overlapping per-replica wall times.

warmup_protocol: One complete eight-replica ensemble per arm using seeds 3000..3007, before measured pairs for each method and budget. Discard timing and scientific summaries. Recreate contexts for every measured invocation; keep compilation cache policy identical between arms.
